report: R0 要求默认运行恢复到 v36 引入前的渲染行为：不得预加载或绘制 rooftops-transition-v36-fullheight.png；保留原文件及历史记录；暂停中的水面、灯影和前景栈道栏杆不得接入。

reproduction.command: npm test -- --test-name-pattern='night-city image renderer|uses the approved single full-height PNG for Rooftops variant seams'
reproduction.observed: The current default renderer preloads night-city-rooftops-transition-v36 and renders it at consecutive Rooftops chunks.

inScope: Remove v36 from the default NightCityRenderer preload and desired-image branch.
Restore the exact pre-v36 mist behavior at every panorama boundary.
Update only directly affected renderer regression assertions.
Keep longmap component preview disabled by default and preserve safe missing-asset skips.
outOfScope: Gameplay input, grapple physics, pursuer parameters, map topology, tutorial, economy, ads, revive, settlement, or save semantics.
Water surface, lantern reflection, foreground market deck rail, and any new art generation.
Seam quality claims, asset URL refactors, platform package work, or PR #1 mutation.

acceptance: Default preload does not include night-city-rooftops-transition-v36.
Default render never creates a v36 carrier image.
Same-district Rooftops joins use night-city-district-transition-mist with the pre-v36 dimensions, depth, and alpha.
Existing panorama, foreground eaves, other district transitions, component preview default, and missing-asset behavior remain unchanged.
The v36 PNG and historical approval/rejection/test records remain present.

route.reason: The regression is localized to one renderer and one directly coupled test; it does not alter gameplay, persistence, schemas, adapters, release configuration, or the default journey.

Historical art candidates and paused water/lighting production details unrelated to runtime removal.
